fullPassage:
The Cambridge Declaration of Consciousness

In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. Consciousness means having subjective experiences or awareness. The scientists found that animals have emotions and can have consciousness like humans. For example, African grey parrots have shown evidence of consciousness that is almost as advanced as that of humans. Even octopuses have the brain structures needed for subjective experiences. Drugs that affect human consciousness also affect some animals in similar ways. So, the scientists concluded that consciousness is not just for humans. Animals can have it too.

Since the Cambridge Declaration, research on animal consciousness has been actively carried out. Scientists are still working to find out exactly how animal consciousness works. Not all animals are conscious, but those with complex nervous systems are more likely to be. All things considered, it would be a wise and safe choice to assume that animals have feelings and to treat them with respect and kindness.

questions.passage: In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about (A)[consciousness / conscience] in humans and animals. Consciousness means having (B)[subjective / objective] experiences or awareness. The scientists found that animals have (C)[emotions / motions] and can have consciousness like humans. For example, African grey parrots have shown evidence of consciousness that is almost as advanced as that of humans. Even octopuses have the brain structures needed for subjective experiences. Drugs that affect human consciousness also affect some animals in similar ways.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 인간과 동물의 의식(consciousness)에 대해 이야기하기 위해 모였다. 의식이란 주관적인(subjective) 경험이나 인식이다. 동물도 감정(emotions)을 가지고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① consciousness — subjective — emotions: 원문 그대로
❌ ② conscience(양심): consciousness(의식)과 철자 유사
❌ ③ objective(객관적인): subjective(주관적인)의 반의어
❌ ④ motions(움직임): emotions(감정)과 철자 유사
det.tip: consciousness(의식) vs conscience(양심), subjective(주관적) vs objective(객관적), emotions(감정) vs motions(움직임)

questions.passage: So, the scientists concluded that consciousness is not just for humans. Animals can have it too. Since the Cambridge Declaration, research on animal consciousness has been (A)[actively / passively] carried out. Scientists are still working to find out exactly how animal consciousness works. Not all animals are (B)[conscious / cautious], but those with complex nervous systems are more (C)[likely / unlikely] to be. All things considered, it would be a wise and safe choice to assume that animals have feelings and to treat them with respect and kindness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 연구가 활발히(actively) 이루어지고 있다. 모든 동물이 의식이 있는(conscious) 것은 아니지만, 복잡한 신경계를 가진 동물은 의식이 있을 가능성이 더 높다(more likely).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ actively — conscious — likely: 원문 일치
❌ ① passively(수동적으로): actively(활발히)의 반의어
❌ ② unlikely(가능성 낮은): likely(가능성 높은)의 반의어
❌ ④ 모두 반의어
det.tip: actively(활발히) ↔ passively(수동적으로), conscious(의식 있는) ↔ cautious(조심스러운), likely ↔ unlikely

questions.passage: The Cambridge Declaration of Consciousness In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. Consciousness means having subjective experiences or awareness. The scientists found that animals have emotions and can have consciousness like humans. For example, African grey parrots have shown evidence of consciousness that is almost as advanced as that of humans. Even octopuses have the brain structures needed for subjective experiences.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 인간의 의식에 영향을 미치는(affect) 약물은 동물에게도 영향을 미친다. 과학자들은 의식이 인간만을 위한 것이 아니라는 결론을 내렸다(concluded). 동물에게도 감정이 있다고 가정하는(assume) 것이 현명한 선택이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② affect — concluded — assume: 원문 일치
❌ ① effect(명사/효과): affect(동사/영향을 미치다)와 혼동
❌ ③ excluded(제외했다): concluded(결론 내렸다)와 발음 유사
❌ ④ consume(소비하다): assume(가정하다)와 철자 유사
det.tip: affect(동사: 영향 미치다) vs effect(명사: 효과), concluded(결론짓다) vs excluded(제외하다), assume(가정하다) vs consume(소비하다)

questions.passage: In 2012, ①<u>③<u>scientists</u></u> met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals. ②<u>Consciousness</u> means having subjective experiences or <u>awareness</u>. The scientists found that animals have <u>emotions</u> and can have consciousness like humans. For ④<u>example</u>, African grey parrots have shown <u>evidence</u> of consciousness that is almost as <u>primitive</u> as that of humans.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 아프리카 회색 앵무새는 인간과 거의 비슷한 ④원시적인(→ advanced 고등 수준의) 의식을 가지고 있다는 증거를 보여주었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ primitive(원시적인)는 원문 advanced(고등 수준의)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ① awareness(인식): 원문 그대로 적절
❌ ② emotions(감정): 원문 그대로 적절
❌ ③ evidence(증거): 원문 그대로 적절
det.tip: advanced(고등 수준의) ↔ primitive(원시적인). almost as advanced as = 거의 ~만큼 발달한

questions.passage: ①<u>Since</u> the Cambridge Declaration, research on animal consciousness has been actively <u>carried out</u>. ②<u>Scientists</u> are still working to find out exactly how animal consciousness works. Not all ③<u>animals</u> are conscious, but those with <u>complex</u> nervous systems are more likely to be. All ④<u>things</u> considered, it would be a wise and safe choice to assume that animals have feelings and to <u>treat</u> them with <u>cruelty</u> and kindness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 동물에게도 감정이 있다고 가정하고 ④잔인함(→ respect 존중)과 친절로 대하는 것이 현명한 선택이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ cruelty(잔인함)는 원문 respect(존중)의 반의어로 부적절. kindness와 병렬이므로 긍정 단어가 필요
❌ ① carried out(수행되다): 원문 그대로 적절
❌ ② complex(복잡한): 원문 그대로 적절
❌ ③ treat(대하다): 원문 그대로 적절
det.tip: respect(존중) ↔ cruelty(잔인함). with respect and kindness = 존중과 친절로

questions.passage: ①<u>Consciousness</u> means having subjective experiences or awareness. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 인간의 의식에 영향을 미치는 약물은 일부 동물에게도 ③다른(→ similar 비슷한) 방식으로 영향을 미친다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ different(다른)는 원문 similar(비슷한)의 반의어로 부적절. '인간처럼 의식이 있다'는 결론을 뒷받침하려면 비슷한 방식이어야 함
❌ ① structures(구조): 뇌 구조라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② affect(영향을 미치다): 원문 그대로 적절
❌ ④ concluded(결론 내렸다): 원문 그대로 적절
det.tip: similar(비슷한) ↔ different(다른). in similar ways = 비슷한 방식으로

❌ ② functions(기능): 구조가 아닌 기능은 다른 의미
❌ ③ damages(손상): 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ symptoms(증상): 의학 용어로 부적절

Drugs that affect human consciousness also affect some animals in similar ways. So, the scientists concluded that consciousness is __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 과학자들은 의식이 인간만을 위한 것이 아니라는 결론을 내렸다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ not just for humans(인간만을 위한 것이 아닌): 원문 그대로. 동물도 의식 가능
❌ ① only for intelligent species: 모든 지적 종은 과잉 일반화
❌ ② impossible for animals: 문맥과 정반대
❌ ③ limited to primates: 영장류 한정은 원문에 없음
det.tip: not just for humans = 인간만을 위한 것이 아닌. conclude that ~ = ~라고 결론 내리다
